subject: Re: Redwood + AcmeCorp — procurement next steps / marketplace interest
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-06-15T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood + AcmeCorp — quick post-call recap & next steps

Hey Alex — thanks for a productive call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum:

Summary
- Goal: Move AcmeCorp from evaluation to pilot for search/assist use case (internal knowledgebase + customer support) by Q3.
- Key stakeholders: Alex Johnson (Platform), Sanjay Rao (Procurement), Eng managers (TBD).

Open questions we need to resolve for commercial path
1) Procurement vehicle: Are you planning to buy via Corporate P-card, PO/Net30, or prefer AWS Marketplace?
2) Contracting: Do you need a SOW + Master Services Agreement (MSA) or will purchase order terms suffice?
3) Marketplace: If Marketplace is preferred, which cloud store (AWS/GCP/Azure) is required and do you have an internal procurement process for marketplace purchases?

Attachments: I attached a draft SOW and a one-pager on our AWS Marketplace onboarding checklist.

Proposed next steps
- Alex to confirm procurement vehicle and marketplace preference (PO vs P-card vs Marketplace).
- If PO preferred: Sanjay or procurement to share required billing/contact info and template.
- If Marketplace: I’ll loop in our Marketplace onboarding lead and share NDA/terms flow.
- Schedule 30-min procurement intro with your finance/procurement team if helpful.

Would you be able to confirm procurement preference and suggested contact for your procurement team?

Thanks — appreciate the time.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.inference
(415) 555-0192

Attachments: Acme_Redwood_SOW_draft.pdf, AWS_Marketplace_Onboarding_Checklist.xlsx

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmecorp.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.inference>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@acmecorp.com>, Sanjay Rao <s.rao@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2026-06-16T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood + AcmeCorp — quick post-call recap & next steps

Hi Camila — thanks for the summary, that captures it well. A few answers from our side:

Procurement vehicle: We prefer PO/Net30 for anything >$50k annually. For smaller pilots we can use card. For this pilot we expect it will be a PO.

Marketplace: We are open to AWS Marketplace for ease of procurement, but we need to confirm whether it works with our internal cost center flows. Primary preference: PO via Direct Contracting. If Marketplace makes billing simpler, we can consider it — need confirmation on reseller terms and whether Redwood will accept SOC2/Audit attachments when onboarding.

Contracting: We will need a standard MSA with a short SOW for the pilot. Procurement asked that you share your standard MSA and a draft SOW to review. Sanjay from procurement is copied — he can take next steps on our side.

Alex

On Tue, Jun 15, 2026 at 10:05 AM Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.inference> wrote:
> Hey Alex — thanks for a productive call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum:

From: Procurement <procurement@acmecorp.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.inference>, Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2026-06-17T08:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood + AcmeCorp — quick post-call recap & next steps

Hi Camila / Alex — Sanjay here from procurement. Thanks for looping me in. A couple of practical notes from procurement:

1) We prefer PO/Net30 for this engagement. Please provide a vendor form and W-9 (US entity) and an invoice template.
2) For Marketplace: AWS Marketplace is acceptable, but only if the SaaS offer supports contract flow that allows us to receive invoices tied to a PO. If Redwood requires consolidated billing that breaks our chargeback flows, we will stick to direct PO.
3) Please send a draft MSA and SOW. We also require proof of SOC2 (or link to audit report) and your data retention policy for customer data processed in the pilot.

Next steps requested from Redwood:
- Vendor onboarding packet (vendor form, W-9)
- Draft MSA and SOW
- SOC2 report link or contact for audit artifacts
- Point of contact for billing and invoicing (name, email, postal address for PO)

I attached our vendor onboarding checklist (see stub). Happy to schedule a 30-min to run through if helpful.

Regards,
Sanjay Rao
Sr. Manager, Procurement
AcmeCorp
procurement@acmecorp.com

Attachments: Acme_Vendor_Onboarding_Request.xlsx

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.inference>

Subject: Re: Redwood + AcmeCorp — procurement next steps / marketplace interest

Thanks Sanjay — appreciate the clear asks. Looping in Marissa (AE) and Dev (SE) — we will get you everything requested. Next steps from our side:

- Today: We will send a vendor packet (vendor form + W-9) and upload our SOC2 link.
- Today: Share draft MSA + SOW (attached). Camila attaching the draft SOW as discussed.
- Tomorrow: Marissa will schedule a 30-min procurement intro with you for PO details and invoicing.
- Marketplace note: We are happy to support AWS Marketplace and will confirm with our Marketplace team whether invoices can be tied to PO/chargeback flows. If there are any obstacles we will notify you immediately and proceed with direct PO.

Action items (owners)
- Camila: Upload SOC2 link + send vendor packet (W-9) — by EOD today.
- Marissa: Schedule procurement intro meeting — by EOD tomorrow.
- Dev: Provide short note on where logs/retention metadata live for audit — by tomorrow.

Thanks again — we’ll be in touch with the packet and DocuSign/DS links.
